nodes.name: Read Expenses Sheet

nodes.name: Prepare Report Context

values.content:
=You are the financial reporting assistant for {{ $env.BUSINESS_NAME }}.

Generate a weekly P&L summary report for the week of {{ $json.week_start }} to {{ $json.week_end }}.

INVOICES DATA (Revenue):
{{ JSON.stringify($('Read Invoices (Revenue)').all().map(i => i.json), null, 2) }}

EXPENSES DATA:
{{ JSON.stringify($('Read Expenses Sheet').all().map(i => i.json), null, 2) }}

SUPPORT LOG DATA:
{{ JSON.stringify($('Read Support Log').all().map(i => i.json), null, 2) }}

Calculate and return a JSON report with these exact fields:
{
  "week_start": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "week_end": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "gross_revenue": 0.00,
  "total_expenses": 0.00,
  "net_profit": 0.00,
  "profit_margin_pct": 0.0,
  "top_client_name": "name",
  "top_client_revenue": 0.00,
  "busiest_day": "Monday",
  "invoices_paid": 0,
  "invoices_outstanding": 0,
  "open_invoices_total": 0.00,
  "support_tickets_total": 0,
  "support_tickets_resolved": 0,
  "support_auto_resolved_pct": 0.0,
  "key_action_next_week": "One specific, actionable recommendation for next week based on the data",
  "performance_vs_prior_week": "Up/Down/Flat with brief context if data available",
  "whatsapp_summary": "A concise WhatsApp-formatted summary (use emojis, keep under 400 chars) with the headline numbers and key action"
}

For whatsapp_summary, format it like:
📊 Week of [date] P&L\n\n💰 Revenue: $X\n📉 Expenses: $X\n✅ Profit: $X ([X]%)\n\n🏆 Top client: [name]\n📋 Open invoices: $X\n🎫 Tickets: X resolved\n\n💡 Next week: [key action]

main.node: Save Report to Weekly Reports Tab

meta.description: Every Friday at 5pm, reads revenue, expenses, and support data from Google Sheets. Claude generates a full P&L summary including gross revenue, net profit, top client, busiest day, open invoices, and a key action recommendation for next week. Sends via WhatsApp and saves to Google Sheets.
